topic: Should a 12-person software company adopt a four-day work week?
context: Current delivery: 14 tickets per week; two employees cover urgent customer issues daily. A 6-week pilot at a peer company reported stable throughput but supplied no control group. The company can fund a 4-week reversible trial, cannot hire, and must keep weekday response coverage. Recommend a decision and a measurable stop rule in under 350 words.
